mapper.insert: insert into safety.safety_staff_evection (staff_no, staff_name, begin_time, end_time, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{param.staffNo}, #{param.staffName}, #{param.beginDate}, #{param.endDate}, #{param.remark}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update safety.safety_staff_evection t set t.begin_time = #{param.beginDate}, t.end_time = #{param.endDate}, t.remark = #{param.remark}, t.update_time = now() where t.staff_no = #{param.staffNo}
mapper.select:
select t.staff_no, s.emp_name staff_name, s.org_name_path staff_group, t.begin_time begin_date, t.end_time end_date, t.remark from safety.safety_staff_evection t left join safety.safety_employee_message s on t.staff_no = s.emp_no where 1=1
and t.staff_no like concat('%',#{param.staffNo},'%')
and t.staff_name like concat('%',#{param.staffName},'%')
and str_to_date(t.begin_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= str_to_date(#{param.beginDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and str_to_date(t.end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= str_to_date(#{param.endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by str_to_date(t.begin_time,'%Y-%m-%d') desc limit #{start}, #{end}
